name: Tokyo Disney Hotels (including Fantasy Springs Hotel)
intro: The hotels run by Tokyo Disney Resort, including Tokyo DisneySea Fantasy Springs Hotel inside the park. Rooms open four months ahead, and the most sought-after hotels and room types can sell out within minutes.

facts.bookAhead: Four months: rooms open at 11:00 on the same date four months before

statusNote: Read from the official Tokyo Disney Resort hotel reservation page. Tokyo DisneySea Fantasy Springs Hotel has its own page, which we have not checked separately.
howToBuy: Book on the official Tokyo Disney Resort website, which is in English.
Rooms open at 11:00 Japan time four months before the night of your stay. For example, a stay on December 15 opens on August 15.
Rooms at Tokyo DisneySea Fantasy Springs Hotel go in minutes. Be logged in before 11:00 and have your dates ready.
rulesToKnow: If the same date doesn't exist four months earlier, rooms open on the 1st of the next month. The official example: an October 31 stay opens on July 1 at 11:00.
Fantasy Springs Hotel has its own reservation page. Check it before booking.

soldOut.label: Hotels near Tokyo Disney Resort on Klook
Park tickets: on sale two months ahead

faq.q: When can I book a Tokyo Disney hotel?
faq.a: From 11:00 Japan time four months before the date of your stay.

faq.q: Does the same rule apply to Fantasy Springs Hotel?
faq.a: Fantasy Springs Hotel has its own reservation page. Check it on the official site before you book.

sources.quote: Reservations are accepted from 11:00 a.m. four months before your planned day of stay
